Message.Name: Stock Connect Daily Quota Balance Message
Message.Description: Provides updates on the Northbound Daily Quota Balance (DQB) for Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect and Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect separately. Updates disseminated around every 5 seconds during trading hours.

Field.Name: StockConnectMarket
Field.Description: Markets connected under Stock Connect Program.

Field.Name: DailyQuotaBalance
Field.Description: Northbound Daily Quota Balance (DQB) value for specified Stock Connect Program. DQB in Renminbi (RMB). NULL when DQB is above/equal 30% of the daily quota; actual value when below 30%; 0 when quota is used up.

Field.Name: DailyQuotaBalanceTime
Field.Description: Time of DailyQuotaBalance. Nanoseconds since Unix epoch UTC, precision to the nearest second.

Message.Name: Stock Connect Market Turnover Message
Message.Description: Provides aggregate turnover under Shanghai-Hong Kong and Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect programs. Aggregate turnover provided separately for Northbound and Southbound trading. For Northbound, Buy+Sell Turnover only provided after market close (typically by 16:00). For Southbound, updates disseminated around every minute during trading hours.

Field.Name: StockConnectMarket
Field.Description: Markets connected under Stock Connect Program.

Field.Name: BuyTurnover
Field.Description: Total turnover of Buy trades from Southbound trading, rounded down to integer. HKD for Southbound; Null for Northbound.

Field.Name: SellTurnover
Field.Description: Total turnover of Sell trades from Southbound trading, rounded down to integer. HKD for Southbound; Null for Northbound.

Field.Name: BuyPlusSellTurnover
Field.Description: Sum of BuyTurnover and SellTurnover, rounded down to integer. RMB for Northbound, HKD for Southbound.
